name: personal-calendar-codemirror
description: Builds app/static/vendor/codemirror.js, the one file of CodeMirror 6 the notepad loads (window.CM).

scripts.build: esbuild entry.js --bundle --format=iife --global-name=CM --minify --legal-comments=eof --banner:js="/* Generated by scripts/vendor/codemirror (npm run build). Do not edit. */" --outfile=../../../app/static/vendor/codemirror.js
